methods: Construct the smallest exact identity in a newly specified legal operation alphabet.
Derive a target-specific relaxation bound for that same explicit alphabet.

original_card.first_experiment: Write a complete operation alphabet outside one named premise and price a baseline before searching identities.
original_card.bottleneck_link: A small-width completed saving changes the bit primitive; a finite-address identity alone is insufficient.
allowed_variations: Choose a fixed larger register count or a specified nonabelian operation family.
scope_change_triggers: Remaining inside the already-excluded three-register abelian model.

actual_scope: Exact paid-call minimum for diag([st],[ts],[e]) in M3(F2[D10]), D10=<s,t|s^2=t^2=e,(st)^5=e> of order ten, with paid labels {s,t} and all rank-one idempotents in M3(F2).
scope_change_reason: The first candidate was a W=4 rational two-relation endpoint, close to open PR #1733 and Discussion #1700. The selected refinement changes the address group to a finite nonabelian quotient whose torsion is explicitly outside PR #1911, and asks a single exact three-call sharing question for a noncentral inverse-rotation pair.
bottleneck_link: Tests whether finite torsion enables shared paid reflection calls across dirty register outputs. A positive local word would still need a separate supplier/compiler and full interface-cost mapping before any conditional-bound consequence.
stop_rule: Exhaust all rank-one idempotent choices and all paid-label words of lengths zero through three in the exact ten-element group algebra; check the four-call direct endpoint and mutation controls. Stop this construction after the complete finite cover and do not infer results for other groups or widths.
evidence: Two independently represented standard-library engines exhaust 178,809 words (1, 56, 3,136, 175,616 by length) with zero target hits through three calls. The direct four-call word is exact. Per-level state digests and the attaining word are recorded in CERTIFICATE.json.
